introduction: 211 Connecticut is a free, confidential service for finding local human services. Phone help is available around the clock and in multiple languages.
description: 211 Connecticut is a free, confidential service for finding local human services. Phone help is available around the clock and in multiple languages.

sections.who: People seeking Connecticut services can use the directory or helpline. Individual programs decide who they can serve.
sections.get: Navigators help locate food, shelter, utility, health and other support. The site also links to child care resources and housing-voucher waiting-list information.

sections.apply:
1. Contact 211

    Dial 211 within Connecticut or 800-203-1234 from outside the state. Relay users can dial 711.

  2. Describe the need

    Ask which providers serve your location and whether there is an intake or appointment requirement.

  3. Follow the referral

    Contact the provider to confirm availability and documents. You can also search 211ct.org.
sections.after: Keep referral details. If help is unavailable, ask 211 for another option rather than assuming all local programs are closed.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using 211 Connecticut. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
